overview_description.description: Salt AI is a contextual AI company that offers a visual development platform for enterprise applications in life sciences and health tech. The company's platform enables research and healthcare teams to integrate, visualize, and deploy AI models. From protein generation and biomarker discovery to clinical evidence synthesis and diagnostics, the company combines enterprise-grade scalability with a visual-first interface, empowering cross-functional teams to accelerate discovery and innovation.

about_short_description.short_description: Salt AI is a contextual AI company that offers a visual development platform for enterprise applications in life sciences and health tech.

product.name: Salt AI Platform
product.description: A visual platform for building and managing AI workflows in life sciences without coding, enabling collaboration and integration of multiple AI models.

product.name: AlphaFold2 (22x Faster)
product.description: An optimized implementation of AlphaFold2 that predicts protein structures from amino acid sequences with 22 times faster inference speed on comparable hardware.

product.name: Chroma Embedding Database
product.description: An open-source embedding database for storing, querying, and managing embeddings and their metadata to support AI applications.

product.name: ColabFold
product.description: A user-friendly interface for running protein structure prediction algorithms like AlphaFold2 and RoseTTAFold in Google Colab.

product.name: HADDOCK Docking
product.description: A flexible docking method for modeling biomolecular complexes, particularly protein-protein interactions.

product.name: Llama 3
product.description: An open-source large language model with improved reasoning and code generation capabilities, developed by Meta.
